title: Intent Signals
description: Score and rank prospects by in-market behavior signals to identify who to contact now, who to monitor, and who to deprioritize.

children.text: Detect which prospects are showing in-market behavior and should be contacted now.

### First-Party Signals (strongest)
Actions taken directly with your product or content:
- Submitted an application or inquiry
- Opened an offer email, especially multiple times
- Clicked a pricing link
- Responded to any previous message
- Visited the site recently (if trackable)

### Behavioral Signals
Patterns that indicate active consideration:
- Multiple emails opened but no reply (reading but hesitating)
- Application submitted but offer not acknowledged
- Responded then went quiet (had interest, hit an obstacle)

### Situational Triggers
Events that create urgency:
- Deadline or enrollment window approaching (within 30 days)
- Previously said "contact me later" and that date has passed
- Career transition or life change signal
- Prior opportunity expired and is a reactivation candidate

### Negative Signals (deprioritize)
- No opens on last 3 or more emails
- Explicitly said not interested
- Contact info bouncing
- Stage stuck for 30 or more days with no engagement

| Signal | Weight |
|--------|--------|
| Application or inquiry submitted | +5 |
| Offer email opened 2 or more times | +4 |
| Prior reply, now quiet | +3 |
| Reactivation date passed | +3 |
| Deadline within 14 days | +3 |
| Deadline 14 to 30 days out | +2 |
| No opens in 14 or more days | -3 |
From the input provided, evaluate each prospect against the signal list and produce a ranked priority list.

```
# Intent Signal Report, [Date]

## Priority 1, Contact Now
| Prospect | Score | Top Signal | Action |
|----------|-------|-----------|--------|
| [name] | [n] | [signal] | [what to do] |

## Priority 2, Contact This Week
| Prospect | Score | Top Signal | Action |
|----------|-------|-----------|--------|

## Deprioritize
| Prospect | Reason |
|----------|--------|
```
